name: opus-deemphasis-aarch64
reason: Cause, counts and output identity of the Opus decoder's joint de-emphasis, one c6g.4xlarge host (Graviton2) from the Linux AArch64 gate image: perf stat user-mode instructions, cycles and branch misses of the gate build of codec-worker at b78dab15, of the change and of the reference on the three Opus file workloads, with digests; perf records with symbol reports of b78dab15, the change and the reference on opus-5.1-256 and opus-speech-24-mono, CELT decoding's time by source line, and the speech workload's front-end and back-end stall counts; the 15 files of FATE's opus directory and the three Opus timing inputs decoded to f32 by triergon-session's decode example at b78dab15 and the change, byte-identical; the stable codec-worker's counts on the codec workloads and the playback workers' SHA-256 at e9596487 and the change; the codec-opus tests; binaries' and inputs' SHA-256, toolchain and host details; cited by docs/status.md for the AArch64 timing of opus-5.1-256.
